attributed_synchronization.comparison_note: Control and candidate attribution came from separate Nsight runs and is diagnostic, not the endpoint timing gate.

interpretation: Pinned nonblocking H2D changed the 358 penalty-token copies from source kind 0 to source kind 1 and removed them as immediate predecessors of long stream synchronization, exactly satisfying that narrow counter prediction. It did not remove the 387 long decode synchronizations: 358 now immediately follow a 4-byte device-to-host copy. The patch therefore moved the host wait to the next scalar readback rather than eliminating the dominant synchronization boundary, consistent with the small 0.3949% profiler-off endpoint gain.
